title: cheilotheca humilis var. glaberrima
intro: Cheilotheca humilis var. glaberrima, commonly known as the Glaberrima Cheilotheca, is a plant species that belongs to the family Gentianaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
